hypothesis: A calibration record with a validity interval must gate fusion: readings outside it are retained for audit but never fused, and the refusal leaves the state exactly as if they had not arrived.
input_data: seed 722026 (PCG64) for one synthetic camera run of 110 ticks
seed 722027: 200 Monte Carlo runs with a declared drift of 0.01 m/tick after tick 59
mathematical_model: CalibrationRecord covers ticks in [valid_from, valid_until); fuse() records first, then refuses with calibration_expired before any arithmetic. After expiry the state is predicted only, P(k + n) = F(n dt) P F(n dt)^T + Q(n dt).
numerical_result: fused 59, refused 41 (first at tick 60), retained 100; shadow equality True; post-expiry ANEES inside: refusing 1.00, fusing grand NEES 14.0 (exact prediction 13.8); final position std refusing 1.358 m vs fusing 0.096 m.
observation_model: Camera positions in the world frame citing cam-cal-1 (valid to tick 60), then cam-cal-2 (valid from tick 100).
